name: Celestial plate fitted (frame)
description: celestial armor of [[METAL_NAME]]: two small ornate filigree plates, each in the form of [[BREAST]], each curved to follow the natural contour of the breast and sitting close against the skin, hugging the form, covering the centre of each breast fully, and one matching small ornate plate in the form of [[HIP]] curved to follow the contour of the pelvic area, tapering and sitting flush against the skin, covering the whole front of the pelvic area completely; every plate is engraved with [[ENGRAVING]] and set with [[GEM]]; each plate hangs against the skin held by magic alone, weightless and unconnected to any other; the rest of the torso, the sides of the hips, the back, shoulders and arms are bare skin
notes: A frame, not a piece to use directly: the double-bracket gaps (metal, breast and hip shapes, engraving, gem) are filled by each hero's celestial-design file, so every sister's celestial armor shares one wording and differs only in those values.
